content: The prevention of vascular disease and mortality in individuals with diabetes requires a person-centered approach as recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). 1) The ADA highlights the importance of individualized care, which involves tailoring treatment plans and health goals to the specific needs of each patient. For individuals at high risk of developing type 2 diabetes, this includes establishing realistic and achievable weight loss targets to reduce risk factors. 2) For patients over the age of 75, it is particularly critical to closely monitor blood glucose levels and hemoglobin A1C values. This careful monitoring aims to prevent the progression from prediabetes to type 2 diabetes, thereby reducing the likelihood of associated complications.
